name: multi-tenant-saas-security
description: A GitHub-authenticated TypeScript SaaS that combines Rust/Wasm tenant checks with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.

scripts.dev: npm run build && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node
scripts.test:deno: npm run build && deno test --config examples/deno/deno.json examples/deno
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config examples/cloudflare-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.verify: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p examples/cloudflare-worker/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run test:node && vitest run --config examples/cloudflare-worker/vitest.config.ts && deno test --config examples/deno/deno.json examples/deno && npm run cloudflare:dry-run && npm run pack:check
